adminaccount.title: Admin Accounts
adminaccount.tip: The identity provider only proves who you are; this table decides whether you may enter the console. Once SSO is enabled, only these accounts can modify data, and signing in to the launcher with SSO additionally requires binding an admin account to a Hutao account.
adminaccount.readonly: This identity is read-only: writes require an admin account once SSO is enabled.

add.subject: Subject
add.subjectPlaceholder: The sub claim from the identity provider

bind.userNamePlaceholder: The email it was registered with
bind.body: Bind “{subject}” to a Hutao account. Once bound, this identity can sign in to the launcher through SSO as that Hutao account.
bind.userNameRequired: The Hutao account email is required

unbind.body: Unbind “{subject}”? This identity will no longer be able to sign in to the launcher through SSO; console sign-in is unaffected.

remove.body: Remove “{subject}”? This identity will no longer be able to sign in.

messages.addFail: Failed to add the admin account
messages.toggleFail: Failed to update the admin account
messages.bindFail: Failed to bind the Hutao account
messages.removeFail: Failed to remove the admin account
